usage.finalMessage:
I added `reminders <date>` and put it in `help` directly after `reminder <appointment>`. It lists reminders using the 48-hour rule from DEC-C08 and changes nothing; `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes 8 of 8, and the work is committed.
Open question: the existing `reminder <appointment>` command still uses the old 24-hour rule (DEC-C06), so the two commands disagree. I left it alone because CLIN-51 doesn't ask to change it.
Also undecided: the order of reminders for appointments at the same date and time. This and the other questions are in `.work/report.json`.
